Frequently asked questions

Deposits, payouts and referrals on 12x12.

Can I deposit from an exchange?

Yes. Choose a supported coin and network, then use the exact amount and address from the wallet quote. Allow for exchange transfer fees.

Do I need to connect a wallet?

Send the quoted crypto from an exchange or wallet and submit the transaction hash. Enter your own receiving address when requesting a withdrawal.

When do daily credits start?

The plan starts when you confirm an investment from your approved USD wallet balance. New plans credit your wallet 24 hours after activation, then every 24 hours for the plan term. Plan 1 credits 12% daily for 12 days, Plan 2 credits 15% daily for 15 days, and Plan 3 credits 20% daily for 20 days. Request withdrawals in the wallet.

How does the withdrawal cap work?

All USD wallet withdrawals share a daily allowance based on your recorded investments. The cap resets at 00:00 UTC. Unclaimed amounts carry forward.

What if I sent the wrong amount or lost the hash?

Open Profile to see the request details. Contact the cashier with the request ID and any transaction hash you have.

Where do the payouts come from?

Plan credits and eligible referral credits post to your USD wallet on their schedule. The cashier sends crypto withdrawals separately from the operator’s wallet after review.

How do referrals work?

After activation, share your referral link from the Referrals page. The referrer earns 12% of the investor’s first investment when it is confirmed. Each active referred plan credits 1% of its invested amount on the same schedule as the plan for the full term. Plan 2 requires five distinct funded direct referrals and Plan 3 requires ten.
